motion.evidence: 18 IntersectionObservers / 208 targets (threshold 0, rootMargin 150-200px); 13 scroll + 22 mousemove listeners; 328 rAF/pass; 2 canvas, 70 draggable, 9 disclosure, 9 tabs, 2 carousels; only 4 @keyframes (obfuscated names animation-6j0toc/jpvf7s/zsk7zs/yh21v4 -> intent read from frames) but 119 transition rules + 15 prefers-reduced-motion rules; no GSAP/Lenis/Framer (hand-rolled). House micro-transition 0.16s ease-out (57x); spring cubic-bezier(0.34,1.56,0.64,1) on entrances; ambient 0.8s/2s ease-in-out loops. Scroll deltas from .motion.scroll_effects kind strings (scale 0.8->0.7, 1->0.8, 0.8->1, 0.7->0.8); entrance = opacity 0->1 @300ms, staggeredEntrance:false (fade, no rise).

notes: Custom variable figmaSans (figmaMono for labels). Distinctive INVERTED weight strategy vs Attio: base ~330 (light, 622 nodes), 400 next, 700 used once -- hierarchy from scale (4x body->display) in a single light family, not weight. Two body sizes both common: 18px (635) and 16px (559). Display pair 56/72px; mobile h1 44px. Tracking tightens with size (-1.44px@72 ~ -2%) and goes POSITIVE for small caps/labels (+0.48-0.6px). fg captured as black; muted slate #697485 = rgb(105,116,133) (4.73:1 on white, passes). Color is LOUD but rationed by LOCATION: chrome is strictly black/white/slate, all chroma (cyan/lime/indigo/orange/gold/green/sky/lavender) lives in content thumbnails, decorative primitive shapes, and per-logo quote glyphs -- the inverse of starving the palette, same discipline. Primary CTA is near-black fill, not a brand hue. The one saturated band is the persistent green (#24cb71) Config announcement bar, which correctly uses BLACK text (9.86:1). surface tokens are nominal (lime-pale panel + light-gray) since most captured surfaces were white or tinted content panels. Elevation: hairline 0 1px + 1px inset rings (black/white) as primary structure; exactly ONE deep shadow (0 24px 70px) reserved for the floating hero demo card. Two repeating-conic-gradient sunbursts (cyan, gold) are the only gradients. A11Y: focus-visible 2px black outline (real), img_alt_ratio 1.0, reduced_motion respected -- BUT 100/215 interactive elements are sub-44px tap targets (defect). dark_mode: supportsDark:true flagged but captured dark values were transparent/black garbage (rgba(0,0,0,0)) -- treat as detected-but-UNVERIFIED, likely a capture artifact. No form inputs captured (input state = empty). Motion fields evidence-backed (see motion.evidence); obfuscated @keyframes names carry no intent so techniques are named from frames, not keyframe names.
